I’m sorry—I don’t have live access to airline databases, so I can’t pull up your specific flight details right now.

1. **Indigo’s official site** – Go to [indigo.in](https://www.indigo.in) → “Track Flight” (or use the mobile app). Enter your booking reference `IND4567` and passenger name to see departure/arrival times, gate information, and any delays.

2. **Flight tracking services** – Websites like [flightaware.com](https://flightaware.com), [flightradar24.com](https://www.flightradar24.com), or apps such as *FliteCheck* let you search by flight number (`IND4567`) or route.

3. **Contact customer support** – Call Indigo’s helpline at +91‑22‑2555‑5555 (India) or use the chat feature on their website/app for personalized assistance.

If you’d like me to draft an email or phone script to inquire about your flight, just let me know!
